## Earnie 2.5.3-alpha.5

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5.3** line (follow-up to `2.5.3-alpha.4`). Focus: fix HA add-on Ingress / host `:8501` **"Not found"**.

### Highlights

- **Ingress nginx proxy** — nginx on `:8501` re-attaches Supervisor `ingress_entry` and proxies to Streamlit on `:8502` with `baseUrlPath`
- **Root cause (alpha.4)** — Streamlit `baseUrlPath` alone; HA strips the Ingress path before the add-on, so both OPEN WEB UI and bare `http://<ip>:8501/` returned Not found
- `EARNIE_STREAMLIT_BASE_URL_PATH` is set only by add-on `run.sh` when the nginx path is active (no blind auto-detect in `run_streamlit`)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3-alpha.5` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.2**).
